$comment: Which EHDS models matter. compositions: the focus models (shown first) and their first-level sections - 'auto' reads the focus model's 'Section: ...' elements, or list them: ["EHDSX", { "title": "...", "models": [...] }]. components: building blocks, hidden by default. tags: free tags per model (EHDS or Belgian name), searchable. Every other EHDS model is 'supporting'. Belgian models take the place of the EHDS models mapped to them.
